**1 — Scene:** Two pieces of cheese-and-tomato pizza, leafy salad, a small portion of penne, cherry tomatoes, broccoli and a black olive.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm per side. Its area is about 676 cm², equivalent to a circular diameter of 29.3 cm: 3.14 × (29.3/2)² ≈ 674 cm².

**3 — Items:** Pizza (including its cheese and tomato sauce), mixed salad leaves, penne pasta, cherry tomatoes, broccoli, a black olive, and a light visible oil/dressing sheen.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Areas are allocated without double-counting overlapping foods. Oil coats the food rather than occupying additional plate area.
